name: Open dashboard and generate furniture seat codes
description: Checks the overview remains usable and the new furniture coding workflow saves seat-only codes with printable barcode labels.
steps: Open the app dashboard and review the inventory overview
Choose G8, stream N, chair, 3 seats and Good condition
Verify HPS-G8-N-CH-01, HPS-G8-N-CH-02 and HPS-G8-N-CH-03 appear without learner names or admission numbers
Export the code register to Excel
Print labels or save the print dialog output as PDF
expected: Dashboard metrics remain visible and the furniture register contains the three seat codes, Code 128 labels and an Excel export action.

name: Add inventory item and validate required fields
description: Checks item form validation and creation.
expected: An empty name is rejected and a completed item can be added.

name: Record barcode issue and block insufficient stock
description: Checks barcode issue tracking and insufficient-stock guardrail.
expected: Oversized issues are rejected and valid transactions are recorded.

name: Learner register fields, validation and editing
description: Verifies requested learner register columns and persistence.
steps: Open People; Students is selected by default
Add learner admission number, name, class, stream, parent and type
Assign a registered dormitory to a boarder
expected: The register displays Admission No, Name, Type, Class, Stream, Dormitory, Parent, Status and Actions; edits persist and duplicate admission numbers are rejected.

name: Delete classes and blocks independently with confirmation
description: Verifies independent class and block deletion.
steps: Create and delete a test class
Create and delete a test block
expected: Only the selected class or block is deleted after confirmation.

name: Download and restore a school database backup
covers: backup restore merge by record ID
description: Checks backup export and non-destructive restore flow.
expected: A JSON backup downloads and restore merges records without deleting unrelated current records.
